mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Ask the system whether an object can be deleted before deleting it.

description: [read-only] Asks SAP whether the object named by object_type and object_name can be deleted: sends the deletion check request for its type, and answers SAP's verdict as it came: deletable true with the object and SAP's message when it carries one, or SAP's refusal with its words. object_type and object_name required: PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, CDS_UNIT_TEST (its test class), PROGRAM [onprem only], INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE (object_name GROUP|MODULE), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

object_name.description: Object name. A function module is named GROUP|MODULE, its function group first.

object_type.description: Object type. Supported: PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, CDS_UNIT_TEST, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION.

name: HandlerDeletionCheck
